decisions.D1: AreaWindowFeatureSchema has an optional packageId (uuid). The window read's proposed CTE selects p.id package_id from the package row it already joins; the recorded arm selects NULL::uuid package_id and the proposal arm p.package_id; windowFeature sets packageId only when the row has one, so a recorded row omits it. Additive: the window's limit (at most 4000 rows), keyset and the summary statement's selected columns are unchanged.
decisions.D2: WindowedInspector passes feature.packageId to BuildingCard, as MapWorkspace passes proposalPackageId; the by-feature target read then asks in that package. A recorded building passes none and is read through the packages that recorded it, as in G04M.

tests.server: area-display-window.test.ts: a proposal from a draft outline and one from a package body each carry their own package id and that package's case; the recorded row carries neither key; the statement selects p.id package_id in the CTE, NULL::uuid package_id on the recorded arm and p.package_id on the proposal arm.
tests.studio: BuildingCard.test.tsx: a proposal picked in a windowed area (WindowedInspector, captured E3B target's feature, package and case) creates one query keyed by feature and package; fetching it sends GET /api/v1/ingestion/intake/targets/by-feature with {featureId, packageId}; the inspector then shows the target's readiness words beside 'Open batch to confirm'. Without the WindowedArea change this test fails on the query key.

inputs: The Studio test uses the captured E3B run (docs/evidence/gf1/e3b/targets.json); the server test uses the in-memory window store of area-display-window.test.ts. No runtime, Docker, GPU or provider call.
